title: Trap and Recover Two Defenders
description: Two defenders trap a ball handler in a corner, then sprint to recover to their own assignments the moment the ball is passed out.

content.objective: Trap aggressively without fouling, then recover quickly once the ball is out of the trap.
content.setup: A ball handler is trapped in the corner by two defenders; two other offensive players wait to receive an outlet.
instructions: Both defenders close the trap at the same time, hands high and active.
The ball handler looks to pass out of the trap as soon as a lane opens.
Both trapping defenders sprint immediately to recover to their own matchups once the pass is released.
Rotate which two defenders trap each round.
coachingPoints: Trap with active hands, not grabbing or reaching in low.
Communicate who recovers to which open player.
Sprint the recovery — a slow jog gives up an easy shot.
commonMistakes: Both defenders recovering to the same player and leaving another open.
Trapping too passively to actually force a rushed pass.
Watching the ball only and losing track of the opponent.
content.safety: Hands stay up and active; no reaching in low where contact is likely.
